annotation.title_clean: Checklist: Privacy considerations when using commercially available AI products
annotation.title_en: Checklist: Privacy considerations when using commercially available AI products
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)
annotation.summary_en: OAIC checklist helping Australian organisations deploying commercially available AI products comply with the Privacy Act's Australian Privacy Principles, covering collection, use and disclosure, accuracy, transparency, and ongoing assurance such as policies, staff training, monitoring and audits.
key_provisions_or_claims: Assess collection or generation of personal information via AI against APP 3 necessity and lawful, fair means
Secondary use or disclosure must meet APP 6 reasonable-expectation tests
Ensure accuracy (APP 10); label AI outputs as probabilistic and keep human verification
Inform individuals of AI use in privacy policy and at collection (APP 1, 5)
Maintain use policies, staff training, monitoring and regular audits across the AI lifecycle
